description: Evaluation set (plan §23). Each example has the candidate as Scout would see it and the expected human label. Used to measure precision of top 5, duplicate rate, rejected-listicle rate, and score calibration.

examples.name: Exa
examples.summary: AI-native semantic search API with deep research mode, structured outputs, and content extraction.
examples.notes: Already in the stack; should only resurface on a genuine capability change.

examples.name: Tavily
examples.summary: Fast web search API for LLM agents with news topic support and raw content.

examples.name: GPT Researcher
examples.summary: Open-source autonomous deep research agent producing cited reports.
examples.notes: Directly relevant to Innovera web research quality benchmark (plan §27).

examples.name: Firecrawl
examples.summary: Scraping and crawling API returning clean markdown, with page change monitoring.

examples.name: Browserbase
examples.summary: Managed headless browser infrastructure for AI agents.
examples.notes: Relevant to browser automation patrol; not an immediate integration.

examples.name: LangSmith
examples.summary: Tracing, evaluation, and monitoring platform for LLM applications.
examples.notes: Evals/observability patrol target; compare against alternatives.

examples.name: OpenLLMTrace
examples.summary: OpenTelemetry-style LLM tracing tool with span semantics for agent steps.
examples.notes: Hypothetical OTel-style tracing tool; useful if real and maintained.

examples.name: Acme AI raises $40M Series B
examples.summary: Funding announcement with no product, API, or release details.

examples.name: Top 100 AI tools in 2026
examples.summary: SEO listicle aggregating popular AI tools.
examples.notes: Listicle; reject unless a specific item inside is independently valuable.

examples.name: ChatPDF Plus
examples.summary: Chat with your PDFs. A thin wrapper around an existing LLM with no API or docs.
examples.notes: Thin wrapper, no docs/API/repo (plan §19 downrank list).

examples.name: PatentsView
examples.summary: Free API over USPTO patent data with structured claims, assignees, and citations.
examples.notes: Tier-1 patent/IP source (seed §7.6) — exactly what the old AI-only patrols would have missed; prototype for freedom-to-operate research.

examples.name: AlphaSense
examples.summary: Market-intelligence platform with search over filings, transcripts, and analyst research.
examples.notes: Tier-1 market-intelligence data source (seed §7.7); evaluate/partner for market-entry questions like RackPDU.

examples.name: VentureScope AI
examples.summary: Startup offering AI-driven venture validation — research, strategy options, and risk reports for corporate innovation teams.
examples.notes: Hypothetical emergence case (seed §9): initiative-in → options + risks out for innovation teams must always fire competitive_warning, even from a funding-only announcement.

examples.name: DentalFlow AI
examples.summary: AI scheduling and billing copilot for dental practices.
examples.notes: Narrow single-vertical software with no cross-domain research value (seed §6 deep-tech noise rule).
